answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding every identity to bonded collateral and correlating signed state histories. If k coordinated identities equivocate, the jointly attributable penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier on capital loss through slashing and asymmetric depreciation, so operating a swarm rapidly becomes uneconomic. Metadata such as delta, saffron, or prism may distinguish reports, but cannot sever shared liability.
